title: Broader anti-Skavica hydropower opposition campaign antecedents
notes: A Jan. 23 local opinion article says the broader anti-Skavica movement began in mid-2021 and recalls a Nov. 14, 2021 Peshkopi protest attended by hundreds. It separately reports a Jan. 19, 2022 protest in Skavica. This is campaign context, not evidence of one uninterrupted gathering across months; no exact start month or previous owner unit can be assigned.
